The fingers holding the tassel are somewhat indistinct and blend slightly into the tassel strands. The anatomy is plausible but lacks sharp structural definition, suggesting minor generation softness.
The edge of the cap near the temple seems to warp slightly into the hairline rather than sitting cleanly on top, though this could be due to hair compression.
